title: Europe's last regular standard-gauge steam passenger service
summary: The article covers the Wolsztyn Railway Depot in Poland, which operates the last regular scheduled steam passenger service on standard-gauge railways in Europe, using heritage locomotives like the Pm36 and Ol49 for regular tourist and commuter routes.
problem_solved: Preserves and maintains the world's last operational scheduled steam railway passenger service for both transportation and cultural heritage purposes.
why_valuable: It represents a unique living piece of railway history, offering both a functional public transportation service and an irreplaceable cultural heritage experience that cannot be replicated anywhere else in Europe.
